# Obed Abernethy

## Overview

- **Age:** Sixty years old  <sub>[v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c2 P0](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0000), [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v1 c25 P0](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0000), [v1 c25 P4](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0004)</sub>

## Appearance

Obed is an unusual-appearing, awkward-framed man who stoops at the shoulders. He has long iron-gray hair reaching his hunching shoulders and a thick, gentle brown beard that he has worn continuously since the age of twenty.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003)_

## Personality

Obed is a bashful, timid, and quiet man who fears women and feels an uneasy sensation that they mock him. Though very shy, he possesses a soft heart and a deeply caring nature, showing a timid radiance of pleasure when allowed to keep and provide for an orphan child.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 c6 P32](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0032), [v1 c25 P0](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0000)_

## Traits

- Bashful and shy around women  <sub>[v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 c25 P0](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0000)</sub>
- Timid  <sub>[v1 c2 P18](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0018), [v1 c6 P32](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0032)</sub>
- Fear of women  <sub>[v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 c6 P37](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0037)</sub>
- Kind and soft-hearted  <sub>[v1 c2 P17](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0017), [v1 c6 P32](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0032)</sub>

## Abilities

- Skilled negotiator for general items  <sub>[v1 c25 P5](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0005)</sub>

## Goals

- To provide Nell with an attractive dress equal to those of her schoolmates  <sub>[v1 c25 P4](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0004)</sub>

## History

Obed Abernethy traveled eight miles on his sorrel mare to Alder River to collect an orphan boy he and his sister Thirza had arranged to take in from Nova Scotia. Upon arrival, he learned that the train had left behind an eleven-year-old girl, Nell Harcourt, instead of a boy. Unable to inform the child of the mistake on the spot, he brought her back to Grey Shutters. Although Thirza initially reacted with astonishment and disappointment, Obed felt compassion for Nell and supported keeping her. Later, during a winter evening, Obed observed Nell among her peers and realized her wardrobe was noticeably plain compared to theirs. Wanting her to have a modern, attractive dress for Christmas, he ventured to Delford to buy fabric. Distracted by a fashionable female clerk in Samuel Lawson's shop, he flusteredly purchased an unwanted garden rake and brown sugar before consulting Mrs. Sowerby to choose and make a stylish gown for Nell.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P0](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0000), [v1 c2 P6](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0006), [v1 c2 P7](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0007), [v1 c2 P17](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0017), [v1 c3 P0](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0000), [v1 c3 P2](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0002), [v1 c6 P31](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0031), [v1 c6 P32](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0032), [v1 c25 P0](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0000), [v1 c25 P2](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0002), [v1 c25 P4](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0004), [v1 c25 P5](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0005), [v1 c25 P7](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0007), [v1 c25 P12](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0012), [v1 c25 P20](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0020), [v1 c25 P24](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0024), [v1 c25 P25](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0025)_

## Background by volume

- Grew his beard continuously starting at twenty years old  <sub>[v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003)</sub>
- Regularly votes Conservative and attends the Presbyterian church  <sub>[v1 c25 P6](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0006)</sub>
